notes.title: An Update Regarding Broilers Future
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 
I want to take a moment to address something important about Broilers. As many of you know, the original creator entrusted me with its future. However, they’ve been absent online for quite some time, and based on what they shared with me about their circumstances, I’m deeply concerned for their well-being.

Out of respect for them and their incredible work, I’ve been hesitant to make any changes or updates to the game. I also don’t feel comfortable continuing to sell it without knowing how they would feel about that. My priority is to honor their vision and legacy while ensuring Broilers remains accessible to those who love it.

As a result, all planned updates are no longer in development. In the coming months, Broilers will transition to a free-to-play game with no microtransactions.
This isn’t the end of Broilers as an idea—it’s simply a step toward preserving what made it special. Thank you for your understanding and for all the support you’ve given.
Till we battle again,
 Ajwct
